commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+3' The resulting corner from Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) is cleared by the defence.
90+2' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brest.
90+1' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) is coming onto the pitch as Marcus Coco cannot continue after picking up an injury.
89' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) for his blatant foul.
87' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
84' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) is desperate to score a goal, but he misses the target after striking the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
81' The current number of shots on goal is 2:1.
80' Antoine Kombouare has decided to make a change. Kelvin Amian (Nantes) replaces Jean-Kevin Duverne.
75' A clumsy foul by Florent Mollet (Nantes) and Clement Turpin blows his whistle.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) is replacing Steve Mounie.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Kamory Doumbia (Brest) for Mahdi Camara.
72' Now Brest have a corner.
72' Antoine Kombouare prepares a substitution. Matthis Abline is replaced by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes).
71' The referee allows time for a substitution. Benie Traore will be replaced by Florent Mollet (Nantes).
71' That will be all from Samuel Moutoussamy who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pedro Chirivella (Nantes).
68' Steve Mounie (Brest) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

67' Brest are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. It's a throw-in for Nantes.

65' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
63' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Clement Turpin signals.

61' Steve Mounie (Brest) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
59' Kenny Lala (Brest) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
58' 69:31 – the ratio of ball possession.
55' Lilian Brassier (Brest) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Benie Traore (Nantes) was quite harsh and Clement Turpin didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' Lilian Brassier (Brest) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

53' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Marco Bizot pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
50' Neat passing move from Brest in order to create new attacking opportunities.
47' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
47' Steve Mounie (Brest) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Clement Turpin has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Benie Traore (Nantes) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Marco Bizot displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Matthis Abline (Nantes) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

42' Matthis Abline (Nantes) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
41' Romain Del Castillo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
40' Matthis Abline (Nantes) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
38' Brest fail to score from a corner as Alban Lafont (Nantes) leaps to collect the ball.
36' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

33' What a chance that is! Mahdi Camara (Brest) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
32' Brest keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
28' Eric Roy is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) suffers an injury and Jonas Martin comes on.
27' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) commits a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for an infringement.
25' Matthis Abline (Nantes) is flagged for offside.
24' Marcus Coco (Nantes) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
22' The game is interrupted now, Marcus Coco (Nantes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
21' Bradley Locko (Brest) has tested the patience of referee Clement Turpin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

20' Steve Mounie (Brest) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
16' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Tino Kadewere (Nantes), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
12' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brest comes to nothing.

9' Bradley Locko (Brest) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the right post, but Alban Lafont has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brest will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' Martin Satriano (Brest) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
4' Nantes play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
1' The game is interrupted. Tino Kadewere (Nantes) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Nantes will kick-off.
Clement Turpin is the one to supervise the game today.
